info.title: Tenant management service
info.description: The tenant management service includes APIs for common platform capabilities like retrieving tenant information.

get.description: Lists the confidential clients of the realm with their rotation status. Secrets are never returned. Requires the client-secret-admin role.

patch.description: Sets the extra email addresses notified about the client's secret. Send an empty list to clear them. The addresses together may be at most 255 characters. Requires the client-secret-admin role.

post.description: Ends the overlap early by deleting the previous secret, for example if it may have been exposed. The current secret is untouched. Fails if there is no previous secret still in use. Raises the client-secret-revoked event. Requires the client-secret-admin role.

Raises the client-secret-rotation-due event for the client's current expiry, instead of waiting for the notice window. The client must be covered and have an expiry. Requires the client-secret-admin role.

put.summary: Opt a client in or out
put.description: Adds or removes the rotation-enabled role of the client. Only allowed when the realm mode is selected, and opting in needs at least one realm admin with an email address. Requires the client-secret-admin role.

post.description: Generates a new secret. The previous secret keeps working for the overlap period. The new secret is never returned; read it in Keycloak. The client must be covered by rotation. Raises the client-secret-rotated event. Requires the client-secret-admin role.

200.description: Dates of the new secret and of the previous one.

get.description: Returns the rotation mode and schedule that apply to the realm. Requires the client-secret-admin role. Tenant admins read their own realm.

put.description: Sets the rotation mode and schedule of the realm. Send only the values to change. The expiration periods are whole seconds and are stored in the Keycloak rotation profile; the notice period is also whole seconds but is stored in the tenant configuration. Expirations must be above zero (the rotated secret expiration may be 0), the rotated secret expiration and the notice period must be shorter than the secret expiration, and turning rotation on needs at least one realm admin with an email address. The rotation policy in Keycloak is updated right away. Requires the client-secret-admin role.

200.description: Settings of the realm after the change.

post.description:
Deprecated; use POST /api/tenant/v2/tenants, which shares this endpoint's implementation but also validates the name length and characters. Creates a tenant. Requires the core realm beta-tester or tenant-service-admin role; tenant users are rejected even with those roles.

By default a new realm is created for the tenant, with the current user as the administrator; the response is sent with status 202 while the realm is provisioned. Users with the tenant-service-admin role can instead set realm to associate the tenant with an existing realm, in which case adminEmail is required and the response is sent with status 200. Only tenant-service-admin users can set realm or adminEmail.

name.description: Name of the tenant. Must be unique (ignoring case) and must not contain special characters such as ! & % - or /. Leading and trailing spaces are removed and repeated spaces are collapsed to one; a name of only spaces is rejected.

realm.description: Existing realm to associate with the tenant. Requires the tenant-service-admin role.

adminEmail.description: Email of the tenant administrator. Requires the tenant-service-admin role.

newRealm.summary: Create a tenant with a new realm

200.description: Tenant is created with an existing realm.

202.description: Tenant is created and its realm is being provisioned.

400.description: The name is missing, the name is invalid or already used, the administrator already has a tenant, or the realm is already associated with a tenant or set without adminEmail.

constraints.isDefined: name should not be null or undefined

value.errorMessage: Value not valid for Tenant name: This tenant name has already been used. Please enter a different tenant name.

delete.description: Deprecated; use DELETE /api/tenant/v2/tenants/{id}, after looking up the tenant ID with GET /api/tenant/v2/tenants?realm={realm}. Archives the tenant with the given realm and disables the realm; the tenant is not deleted. Requires the core realm tenant-service-admin role.

parameters.name: realm
parameters.description: Realm of the tenant to archive.

example.errorMessage: tenant with ID 'realm: 2f6c8f1e-3b7a-4d5c-9e8f-1a2b3c4d5e6f' could not be found.

post.description: Deprecated; use GET /api/tenant/v2/tenants?adminEmail={email}. Retrieves the tenant with the given administrator email. No role is required. Tenant users can only retrieve their own tenant, and get 404 for any other tenant; core users can retrieve any tenant.

Deprecated; use GET /api/tenant/v2/tenants?name={name}. Retrieves the tenant with the given name, ignoring case. No role is required. Tenant users can only retrieve their own tenant, and get 404 for any other tenant; core users can retrieve any tenant.

get.description: Deprecated; there is no v2 replacement. Returns the Keycloak roles of the realm that issued the current user's token, which is the user's own tenant realm. Requires the tenant-admin role.

Deprecated; use GET /api/tenant/v2/tenants?realm={realm}. Retrieves a tenant by realm. No role is required. Tenant users can only retrieve their own tenant, and get 404 for any other realm; core users can retrieve any tenant.
Internal endpoint used by the tenant admin webapp. Checks if the given user in the core realm is linked to the default ADSP identity provider. Requires the tenant-admin role and is rate limited.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: ID of the user in the core realm.

200.description: Whether the user is linked to the default identity provider in the core realm.

400.description: userId is missing, or the identity providers of the user could not be read.

constraints.isDefined: userId should not be null or undefined

checkFailed.summary: Identity providers could not be read

value.errorMessage: Failed to check the goa-ad IdP in core for user 3d1c5e7a-9b2f-4c6d-8e0a-1f3b5d7c9e2a due to Request failed with status code 404

get.description: Internal endpoint used by the tenant admin webapp. Looks up the ID of the user with the given email in a realm, which defaults to the core realm. Requires the tenant-admin role and is rate limited. Tenant users can only look up users in their own realm or the core realm; core users can use any realm.

parameters.name: realm
parameters.description: Realm to look up the user in. Defaults to core.

200.description: ID of the user, or null if there is no user with the email.

403.description: Tenant user is not permitted to use the realm of another tenant.

example.errorMessage: User Test User (ID: 3d1c5e7a-9b2f-4c6d-8e0a-1f3b5d7c9e2a) not permitted to find user.

delete.description: Internal endpoint used by the tenant admin webapp. Removes the link between a user and an identity provider in a realm. Requires the tenant-admin role and is rate limited. Tenant users can only act on their own realm or the core realm; core users can use any realm.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: ID of the user in the realm.

parameters.name: idpName
parameters.description: Alias of the identity provider. Defaults to goa-ad.

400.description: A required parameter is missing, or the identity provider link could not be removed.

constraints.isDefined: realm should not be null or undefined

value.errorMessage: Failed to delete the IdP goa-ad from user 3d1c5e7a-9b2f-4c6d-8e0a-1f3b5d7c9e2a due to Request failed with status code 404

403.description: Tenant user is not permitted to use the realm of another tenant.

example.errorMessage: User Test User (ID: 3d1c5e7a-9b2f-4c6d-8e0a-1f3b5d7c9e2a) not permitted to delete user identity provider link.

get.description: Deprecated; use GET /api/tenant/v2/tenants/{id}. Retrieves a tenant by ID. No role is required. Tenant users can only retrieve their own tenant, and get 404 for any other tenant; core users can retrieve any tenant.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the tenant, without the URN prefix.

get.description:
Search for active tenants; tenants that are still provisioning or archived are not included. No role is required. Authenticated tenant users only find their own tenant; authenticated core users, including service accounts, can find any tenant.

Archived tenants are only returned when status is archived, which requires the core realm tenant-service-admin role.

Anonymous requests (without a valid bearer token) are allowed if they include the name or realm criteria, and the results do not include the administrator email.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the tenant, matched as a whole and ignoring case.

parameters.name: adminEmail
parameters.description: Email of the tenant administrator. Anonymous requests must also include name or realm.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Status of the tenants to find. Archived requires the core realm tenant-service-admin role.

anonymous.summary: Anonymous request, without the administrator email

401.description: Anonymous request does not include name or realm criteria, or the request for archived tenants is not from a core tenant-service-admin.

example.errorMessage: Request must include realm id or name criteria.

post.description:
Create a tenant. Requires the core realm beta-tester or tenant-service-admin role; tenant users are rejected even with those roles.

By default a new realm is created for the tenant, with the current user as the administrator; the response is sent with status 202 while the realm is provisioned, and a beta-tester who is already the administrator of a tenant is rejected. Users with the tenant-service-admin role can instead set realm to associate the tenant with an existing realm, in which case adminEmail is required and the response is sent with status 200. Only tenant-service-admin users can set realm or adminEmail.

name.description: Name of the tenant. Must be unique, ignoring case. Leading and trailing spaces are removed and repeated spaces are collapsed to one; a name of only spaces is rejected.

realm.description: Existing realm to associate with the tenant. Requires the tenant-service-admin role.

adminEmail.description: Email of the tenant administrator. Requires the tenant-service-admin role.

newRealm.summary: Create a tenant with a new realm

200.description: Tenant created with an existing realm.

202.description: Tenant created and its realm is being provisioned.

400.description: Request is invalid, for example the name is invalid or already used, the administrator already has a tenant, or the realm is already associated with a tenant or set without adminEmail.

value.errorMessage: Validation failed with error(s): name (body) - Invalid value
Value not valid for Tenant name: This tenant name has already been used. Please enter a different tenant name.
test.admin@gov.ab.ca is the tenant admin in our record. One user can create only one realm.

401.description: Request does not include a valid bearer token, the user does not have the required role, or a user without the tenant-service-admin role set realm or adminEmail.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the tenant, without the URN prefix.

get.description: Retrieves a tenant. No role is required, but the request must be authenticated. Tenant users can only retrieve their own tenant, and get 404 for any other tenant ID; core users can retrieve any tenant.

delete.description:
Archives a tenant: its realm is disabled, so users can no longer sign in, and the tenant and realm are retained. Archiving an archived tenant has no effect. Use the restore endpoint to recover an archived tenant. Requires the core realm tenant-service-admin role, which can archive any tenant; tenant users are rejected.

Set purge to true to permanently delete an archived tenant and its realm. Purge also requires the core realm tenant-purge role and responds 400 if the tenant is not archived.

parameters.name: purge
parameters.description: Permanently delete the archived tenant and its realm.

200.description: The archived tenant, or for purge the result of the deletion. success is false if the realm or the tenant record wasn't deleted.

400.description: Request is invalid, for example the tenant is not archived for purge, or is still provisioning.

example.errorMessage: Tenant must be archived before it can be purged.

403.description: Purge was requested without the core realm tenant-purge role.

example.errorMessage: User Test User (ID: 3d1c5e7a-9b2f-4c6d-8e0a-1f3b5d7c9e2a) not permitted to purge tenant.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the tenant, without the URN prefix.

patch.description: Update the tenant name. Requires the core realm tenant-service-admin role, which can rename any tenant; tenant users, including tenant administrators, are rejected. Rate limited. The name must not be used by another tenant (compared ignoring case), so a duplicate responds 400; renaming a tenant to its own current name, or changing only its case, is allowed.

name.description: New name of the tenant. Must be unique, ignoring case. Leading and trailing spaces are removed and repeated spaces are collapsed to one; a name of only spaces is rejected.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the tenant, without the URN prefix.

post.description: Restores an archived tenant: its realm is enabled again and its status is active. Requires the core realm tenant-service-admin role; tenant users are rejected.

example.errorMessage: Only an archived tenant can be restored.

ClientId.name: clientId
ClientId.description: Keycloak client ID of the client, URL encoded because it usually contains colons.

RotationBadRequest.description: Request is invalid: a value is not valid (mode, schedule, contacts), the action is not allowed in the current mode, or the realm has no admin with an email address.

example.errorMessage: mode must be one of off, selected.

RotationForbidden.description: User has neither the client-secret-admin nor the tenant-admin role, is a core user, or has no bearer token.

example.errorMessage: User Test User (ID: 3f2b8c1e-5d4a-4f6b-9c7e-1a2b3c4d5e6f) not permitted to manage client secret rotation.

RotationNotFound.description: The realm or the client was not found. Clients of the rotation service itself are not listed.

example.errorMessage: Client with ID 'urn:ads:my-tenant:my-service' could not be found.

RotationUnauthorized.description: Request does not include a valid bearer token from a tenant realm.

TenantBadRequest.description: Request is invalid, for example a parameter failed validation.

example.errorMessage: Validation failed with error(s): name (body) - Invalid value
Tenant with ID '61f2e3a8c9b1d2e3f4a5b6c7' could not be found.

TenantTooManyRequests.description: Too many requests; limited to 200 requests per 5 minutes.

text/plain.example: Too many requests, please try again later.

TenantUnauthorized.description: Request does not include a valid bearer token, or the user does not have the role required for the operation. Role checks in this API respond with 401 rather than 403.

expirationPeriod.description: Secret expiration in seconds, the time between generating new secrets. Stored in the Keycloak rotation profile.

noticePeriod.description: Seconds before expiry that contacts are notified. Stored in the tenant configuration.

rotatedExpirationPeriod.description: Rotated secret expiration in seconds, the time the previous secret keeps working after a rotation. Always smaller than expirationPeriod. When 0, the previous secret is removed immediately.

minNoticeGapDays.description: Minimum days between notices. Set by platform administrators.

defaults.description: Platform defaults used until the realm has a rotation profile in Keycloak.

id.description: Keycloak internal ID of the client.

optedIn.description: Whether the client holds the rotation-enabled role.

covered.description: Whether rotation applies to the client under the realm mode.

rotatedSecretExpiresAt.description: When the previous secret stops working. Only present after a rotation.

contacts.description: Extra email addresses notified for this client. Realm admins are always notified.

status.description: failed means the secret has expired.

RotationMode.description: off: nothing rotates. selected: only clients that opt in with the rotation-enabled role.

realm.description: Keycloak realm of the tenant, which is the issuer of the tenant's access tokens.

status.description: Status of the tenant; a new tenant is provisioning until its realm has been created. An archived tenant has its realm disabled.

adminEmail.description: Email of the tenant administrator. Not included for anonymous requests.

deletedAt.description: Time the tenant was archived. Only included for an archived tenant.

example.errorMessage: Tenant with ID '61f2e3a8c9b1d2e3f4a5b6c7' could not be found.

constraints.isDefined: email should not be null or undefined
